questions.question: Explain how a country's position in the Demographic Transition Model affects its population pyramid shape

points.text: Stage 2 (e.g. Nigeria): high BR, falling DR -> wide base (many young), narrow top (few elderly), pyramidal. Stage 4 (e.g. UK): low BR, low DR -> narrower base, wider top, columnar. Stage 5 (e.g. Japan): BR<DR -> contracting base, bulge at top, inverted pyramid
